description: This file defines the Subscription model class for the OpenCart admin extension. It provides methods to retrieve subscription data and total counts from the database, applying various filters related to dates, status, and grouping.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for handling subscription reports, providing methods to fetch subscription summaries and counts with filtering options.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves summarized subscription data from the database, supporting filtering by date ranges, status, and grouping interval (day, week, month, year).

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns total count of subscription records, filtered by status and date, with grouping by day, week, month, or year.
